name: Meshy
shortDescription: Text and image to 3D assets. Pricing page showed a $0 option and no-card language.
longDescription: Meshy turns text and images into 3D assets. The pricing crawl showed $0 and no-credit-card language, with a paid sample around $20 per month. Confirm inclusions on the pricing page. We did not create an account or generate a model.
bestFor: Quick 3D assets for a game or prototype
Creators who want a $0 way to try the product
notIdealFor: Final production modeling without an artist pass
strength: The pricing page shows a $0 plan and says no credit card is needed to try text-to-3D and image-to-3D.
weakness: The paid monthly price was shown as animated digits, so a starting price was not confirmed.
smokeTestNotes: No local install attempted (SaaS/desktop/extension or install not feasible without account).

useCaseFit.make-3d: Turns text or a picture into a 3D asset.
